evidence.detail: no league top-8 achievement class exists; PD500Top8 and KickoffTop8 exist only for Gatherling events
LeaguePlayer is the only league-specific achievement; it counts entries, not standings
league standings are never stored in the db, they're calculated anew any time anyone views the league — this is the core blocker

triage.notes: Requires either storing final league standings at league-close time (schema/data change, so needs-product-decision borderline) or constructing a complex SQL query that derives top-8 rank from existing win/loss records; the latter may be infeasible given how leagues work. The design decision is where to store or derive standings.
